_meta.purpose: Job conventions registry (u_3430~3436). Base contract(och §1M) references this; conventions grow HERE as data, contract stays thin. orch reads on demand for instant target-resolution(no open search).
_meta.how: task-request -> match job by keyword -> read its convention -> resolve target via path_formula + state pointer -> dispatch recipe. No deliberation for registry-covered jobs.
_meta.exec_model: u_3437: a job = 1 step, OR sequential steps, OR parallel(when no critical dependency). each job has 'exec': {mode: single|seq|parallel, steps:[...], deps:{stepX:[prereq...]}}. mode=seq -> run steps in order(each waits prev). mode=parallel -> run concurrently EXCEPT where deps require order. single -> one action. orch/worker read exec to know order without deliberating.
_meta.experience_bank: /Users/bumsuklee/git/kong-agent-experience-bank-/<country>/<lang>/<site>/<domain>/ (+ _common/<domain>/). country=primary axis. consult BEFORE + write EXP after. e.g. 네이버구매→KR/ko/naver-shopping/purchase.

yt_fortune_upload.notes: dir prefix = {gen_date=YYYYMMDD}_{target_date=YYYY-MM-DD}; use target_date. drag file-row from Finder only(no browser-open mp4, no file-picker button).

steps: per_scene[1..12]: drag_file -> input_title -> set_playlist -> publish -> next
